basic.title: Page, header and sections
basic.description: PageHeader renders the h1 with actions; each PageSection is a region named by its h2.

stat-cards.title: Stat cards
stat-cards.description: StatCard pairs a label and value in a description list; 0 is rendered.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.description: Toolbar groups controls in a wrapping row; density="compact" and wrap={false} tighten it.

PageProps.maxWidth: Maximum width: numbers are pixels, strings are CSS lengths (style wins)

PageHeaderProps.title: Heading content
PageHeaderProps.description: Supporting text under the heading; omitted when empty (0 is rendered)
PageHeaderProps.actions: Actions shown next to the heading (wrap below it on narrow widths)

PageSectionProps.icon: Decorative icon before the title, hidden from assistive technology

StatCardProps.label: Metric name
StatCardProps.icon: Decorative icon, hidden from assistive technology

ToolbarProps.ref: Ref to the toolbar div (or to the slotted child with asChild)
ToolbarProps.wrap: Wraps controls onto multiple lines; false keeps one bounded row
ToolbarProps.density: Gap between controls: default (space-3) or compact (space-1, with centered direct-child vertical dividers)
ToolbarProps.asChild: Applies the toolbar props, classes and ref to its single child (e.g. a Card) instead of rendering a wrapper div

cssVars.--page-padding: Padding around the page content (smaller on narrow screens by default)
cssVars.--page-gap: Space between the header and the sections
cssVars.--page-title-font-size: Font size of the page title
cssVars.--page-section-gap: Space between the blocks of a section
cssVars.--page-section-padding: Inner spacing of a framed page section
cssVars.--page-stat-card-padding: Inner padding of a stat card
cssVars.--page-stat-card-radius: Corner radius of a stat card (defaults to --radius-lg)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: <minerva-page> is the padded column (max-width caps it); <minerva-page-header> renders the h1 with a description and actions, <minerva-page-section> a region labelled by its h2. the React library's title is heading here.

stat-cards.title: Stat cards
stat-cards.description: <minerva-stat-card> renders a labelled metric (<dl>) from label / value / description attributes or slots, with an optional icon slot. The section also has an icon.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.description: <minerva-toolbar> groups controls in a wrapping row (role="group", name it with aria-label); inputs grow, density="compact" tightens the gap and centers vertical dividers, nowrap keeps one row.

props.heading: Text of the page's h1 (the React library's title).

slots.heading: Heading content (alternative to the heading attribute).
slots.description: Supporting text (alternative to the description attribute).
slots.actions: Actions next to the heading (they wrap below it on narrow widths).

props.heading: Text of the section's h2 (the React library's title).

slots.heading: Heading content (alternative to the heading attribute).
slots.description: Supporting text (alternative to the description attribute).

props.nowrap: Keeps the controls on one bounded row instead of wrapping.

slots.label: Metric name (alternative to the label attribute).
slots.value: Metric value (alternative to the value attribute).
